caption: MCP Elicit Result
description: The client's response to an elicitation request. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 ElicitResult; 2026-07-28 ElicitResult).
name: mcp_elicit_result

mcp_meta.description: MCP member `_meta`: See [General fields: `_meta`](/specification/2025-11-25/basic/index#meta) for notes on `_meta` usage.

mcp_action.description:
MCP member `action` (required by the protocol): The user action in response to the elicitation.
- "accept": User submitted the form/confirmed the action
- "decline": User explicitly decline the action
- "cancel": User dismissed without making an explicit choice

mcp_elicit_result__content__entry_list.description:
MCP member `content`: The submitted form data, only present when action is "accept" and mode was "form".
Contains values matching the requested schema.
Omitted for out-of-band mode responses.

mcp_additional_members.description: Members the pinned definition does not name, exactly as reported, in source order.

mcp_nonconforming_members.description: Named members whose value does not fit the pinned definition, exactly as reported.
